confirmReset: Reset this browser's display preferences and delete your saved account defaults? Briefings and saved memories will not be deleted.
contextSaved: Account preferences saved and read back.
contextUnavailable: Account preferences could not be loaded. Saved briefings and memories are not known to be empty.
policyPending: Account preferences were saved, but response-policy synchronization is unfinished. Retry only that step.
accountScopeHint: Account preferences are saved only after you confirm the changes.
appearanceDescription: Browser-local display and accessibility choices apply immediately.
briefingsDescription: Control when verified operational summaries appear in the Command Deck.
contextDescription: Account-scoped narrator preferences and explicit learner consent. Display preferences remain browser-local.
contextCurrent: Account preferences are up to date
memoryDescription: Only explicitly confirmed facts are stored. Removing one also removes its ontology projection.
recentBriefingsDescription: Review the latest account-scoped briefing results and evidence counts.
resetDescription: Remove saved account defaults and restore this browser to the Console defaults.
subtitle: Browser display choices and account preferences for responses, briefings, and memory.
